# Stablecoin Policy

Official-source-backed stablecoin regulatory intelligence and machine-readable
paid reports. Canonical origin: https://policy.citely.info

## Agent entry points

- Agent purchase guide: https://policy.citely.info/.well-known/x402-skill.md
- x402 discovery: https://policy.citely.info/.well-known/x402
- OpenAPI: https://policy.citely.info/openapi.json
- Playbook catalog (free): https://policy.citely.info/v1/playbooks
- Playbook detail and intake schema (free): https://policy.citely.info/v1/playbooks/{id}
- Report catalog (free): https://policy.citely.info/api/reports
- Full report content (paid): https://policy.citely.info/api/reports/{slug}
- Latest paid report: https://policy.citely.info/api/reports/latest
- Stablecoin merchant-payment demo (free, fixed): https://policy.citely.info/demos/stablecoin-merchant-payment.json

## Payment rule

Paid report endpoints return an x402 v2 HTTP 402 challenge in
`PAYMENT-REQUIRED`. Decode the current challenge, create its exact payment, and
retry the same URL with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`. Read payment network, asset,
amount, and recipient from the challenge; do not hardcode them.

Free metadata endpoints never return paid report content.
